fact: WHO Chad reports DHIS2 is used in all 23 provinces and all 139 functional districts, with promptness rising from 80% to 100% and completeness from 80% to 93% for facilities with DHIS2, and DHIS2 used for COVID-19 and routine vaccination and malaria campaigns.
